content.comment_body: Hello, I have [product_name] [version_no] installed on my laptop running Windows 8.1. It was working well for months, but suddenly today it freezes whenever I try online simulation with my [product_name] [article_no]. The simulation begins, shows the colored wires and some outputs activate, but then the program stops responding and can't be closed. Nothing has changed, and I was using it all day. I’m still able to load programs to the device. Restarting both the computer and PLC hasn't helped. Please assist—I'm on a tight schedule and this issue is causing major delays.

Hello, On your PC, navigate to: C:User/<your user Name>. In this folder, look for directories such as .[product_name]x.y. Delete the one with the same [version_no] as your installed [product_name] software. Restarting [product_name] will recreate this folder with default settings, such as colors. Try again after this. Additional recommendations: Update your Java version on the PC. Check your [product_name] program for Network I/O usage, and verify that network addresses are consecutively numbered (e.g. NI1, NI2, NI3 or NQ1, NQ2, NQ3). If numbering gaps exist, online testing may sometimes fail.

Thanks for your reply. I updated Java but it didn’t help. I then upgraded [product_name] from [version_no] to [version_no], which worked for a few days, but now it’s back to freezing again. I think my network I/O settings may have gaps, so I’ll check that next.

I’m experiencing the same issue. I deleted the folder, updated [product_name] to [version_no], and updated Java as well. I’m considering switching away from [company_name] products, even though I’ve purchased licenses and multiple [product_name] devices. If anyone has any additional ideas, please share. Thanks!
Try running [product_name] as administrator, or use compatibility mode set to another Windows version similar to yours. These steps might help resolve the issue.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members are repeatedly encountering freezing issues while running online simulations on [product_name], regardless of software version or after typical troubleshooting steps such as Java updates, reinstalling, and configuration resets. The problem persists across different setups and devices, resulting in mounting frustration and disruptions to users’ work schedules.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to perform reliably and stably during online simulation, with no sudden crashes or freezes, and anticipate prompt solutions or recovery methods for these technical issues.
